subject.title: Control UI Dashboard v2 freezes on Chrome 146 (works fine in Firefox)

question: Should this issue be handled by first proving and removing a current Chromium render trigger, or should OpenClaw add an explicit browser-safe fallback mode for affected Control UI users?
rationale: The report is credible, but current main has moved the UI code and added partial mitigations without live proof of the current trigger; choosing a fallback or browser-specific mode changes user-visible Control UI behavior.

options.title: Reproduce Then Fix Trigger
options.body: Use live Chromium diagnostics on current main to identify the shell/layout trigger and land the narrowest verified fix.

options.title: Add Safe UI Fallback
options.body: Design an explicit simpler shell or safe-mode fallback for affected Chromium builds, accepting a broader product surface.

options.title: Close After No Repro
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide current-main Chromium proof no longer reproduces and the report is no longer actionable.

recommendation.title: Reproduce Then Fix Trigger
recommendation.body: Use live Chromium diagnostics on current main to identify the shell/layout trigger and land the narrowest verified fix.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev has the strongest Dashboard v2 and responsive-refresh feature-history trail for this surface.
